decisions.reason: A responsive website template is related to the customer base but is comparatively easy to imitate and less central than managed hosting and support, so we would likely discontinue it and focus resources on stronger recurring offerings.
Premium customer support sits at the heart of our managed-service positioning and supports recurring revenue and customer retention, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The software version management tool fits our technical platform capabilities and helps reduce operational work for customers, so it should remain unless usage and maintenance economics deteriorate.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship offer that directly matches our strategic direction, core infrastructure, and target customers, making discontinuation very unlikely.
